scope: Explicit universal conditional theorem conjoined with an actual composite-order positive control. Hasse is a premise; no full cyclotomic-field/geometric-torsion equivalence or all-p<500 census is claimed. Unsigned producer standing.
statement: For every prime p at least5 and every integer r>2 dividing the actual point count of a nonsingular general Weierstrass curve, its source supersingular trace condition together with the explicit Hasse bound implies modular embedding order2, with no primality assumption on r. An unconditional actual F7 curve/control has8points, P=(3,3) of order8, and modular embedding order2.
